en: The monkey grabbed my samosa and ran away
lang: bandar mera samosa chukk ke bhaaj gya

en: My friend ran after the monkey
lang: mera dost bandar de pichhe bhaaj gya

en: But the monkey climbed up the tree
lang: par bandar perh te chadh gya

en: Then we bought ice cream instead
lang: phir asi ice cream kharid leyi

en: Lunch was very fun, we enjoyed it
lang: lunch bahut mazedaar si, sanu bahut maza aaya
